svg.title: Proposed tray-solver interaction
svg.desc: Sequence: Scheduler builds Input, calls Solve; the solver reads the topological order, records blocker moves and dependencies in a Result and returns it; Scheduler applies the Result to the DAG.

g.text: The solver only reads the DAG. Blocker moves and edges are recorded in the returned Result; Scheduler replays them into ctx->event_dag in one step, so a failed Solve leaves ctx
